title: Shimreishang Kala Maitonphi
alternate_titles: The Ballad of Shimreishang and Maitonphi
notes: Legendary 17th-century tragic romance ballad originating from Phungcham village. Documented in oral histories and theatrical works.

lines_translation: Love dwells deep in the heart of Shimreishang.
Maitonphi is the fairest flower of the land.
Beside the clear running streams of Phungcham.

lines_tangkhul: Atonphi wui sam kaphana won thada.
lines_translation: In our Phungcham village, deep affection grew.
At that sacred time, our generation was transformed by love.
Maitonphi's beauty blossomed like the wild mountain flower.

lines_tangkhul: Shimreishang na khangayei wui tui kashak.
lines_translation: Shimreishang's enduring vow of lifelong faithfulness.
Shall never fade through the turning of generations.
Under the divine gaze of the Creator, true love endures.
